Test whether the adverse embedded HEAD is nevertheless a provider-native exact source-content witness: the checksum-bound archive's embedded Git repository must be structurally valid, clean at aa021231cdafb6d74ce9ab5f55f824a3032058a4 and expose the same root tree as the current GitHub exact commit; every non-.git archive path, type, byte and executable bit must equal the immutable GitHub codeload at that full revision; archive and exact revision rights must be MIT. Absence, a project-level trusted-publisher assertion, a workflow run or local reproduction is insufficient.

index_91_archive_normalization.format: gzip-compressed TAR only; any other response fails closed
index_91_archive_normalization.root_rule: Every archive member must be safe and beneath exactly one top-level repository root.
index_91_archive_normalization.dvcs_envelope_rule: The sole <root>/.git subtree is separated from the software payload manifest, not silently discarded: it must pass git fsck, authenticate the frozen HEAD and tree, and the extracted worktree must be clean. No other path is excluded.
index_91_archive_normalization.payload_manifest: After removing one top-level root and the separately adjudicated .git subtree, include every regular file and symbolic link with normalized path, entry type, SHA-256 of bytes or symlink target, byte count and executable-bit state. Reject duplicates, hard links, devices, unsafe paths and encrypted content.
index_91_archive_normalization.codeload_manifest: Remove exactly one codeload root and include every regular file and symbolic link under the same fields; no path is excluded.
index_91_archive_normalization.equality: Pass only if the two sorted payload manifests are exactly equal and the embedded Git HEAD tree equals the GitHub exact-commit tree. Any extra, missing, differing, dirty or untracked worktree path fails closed.
index_91_archive_normalization.large_payloads: Do not retain raw archive bodies. Retain URLs, statuses, byte counts, MD5/SHA-256, full normalized manifests and selected Git receipts.
